purpose: One integration test for AC-16102-3 driving rcf verify run in its default agent mode through bin/rcf.js against a stand-in agent CLI that runs the project's feedback Stop hook.
title: Headless agent session feedback ask: rcf verify run spawns the agent with RCF_FEEDBACK_ASK=0 so a queued entry cannot become its final output

testCases.description: rcf verify run in its default agent mode spawns the agent with RCF_FEEDBACK_ASK=0; the project's Stop hook exits 0 silently inside the session, the --ask-now entry stays pending and the report carries the agent's findings, not LAUNCH-FAILURE
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/headless-session-feedback-ask.test.js::AC-16102-3: rcf verify run in its default agent mode spawns the agent session with RCF_FEEDBACK_ASK=0, so the project's feedback Stop hook exits 0 silently inside it, a pending --ask-now entry stays pending, and the report carries the agent's findings instead of LAUNCH-FAILURE
